map.薄透镜成像（本页代码口径）：1÷f=1÷d_o+1÷d_i，页面按像距 d_i=: Thin-lens imaging (as implemented here): 1÷f=1÷d_o+1÷d_i, solved for the image distance d_i=1÷(1÷f−1÷d_o) (m, f focal length, d_o object distance); linked values: magnification m=−d_i÷d_o, optical power=1÷f (1/m). Validation: both fields are required by the input guard and must be valid numbers, otherwise a prompt is shown and the calculation stops. Criteria: d_i>0 is a real image, d_i<0 a virtual one, |m|>1 magnified and |m|<1 reduced.
